[USER] The user asked for a good way to incorporate HIIT into their cardio routine and how many times a week they should do it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that HIIT involves short bursts of high-intensity exercise followed by brief periods of rest or low-intensity exercise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps to incorporate HIIT into a cardio routine:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose a type of cardio (running, cycling, swimming, etc.).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Warm up for 5-10 minutes at moderate intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Perform 20-30 seconds of all-out effort followed by 1-2 minutes of active recovery.
